examples.detection_method: Monitor package.json dependency updates and alert on unexpected version bumps. Verify package signatures on install. Use static code analysis to detect suspicious code patterns in dependencies, such as child_process or network socket usage in libraries not expected to have them. Network monitoring for uncommon outbound connections from developer or CI/CD environments. Correlate git commit authorship with known maintainers. Alert on anomalous npm publish IPs and times.
